questions.q_en: In an election, a voter has choice to vote for one candidate out of three candidates. There is also an option 'None of The Above' [NOTA] to reject all candidates. The three candidates get votes that are 6 times NOTA. The winner gets votes that are twice the second runner-up's votes. The first runner up gets 900 votes more than NOTA and defeats the second runner-up by 150 votes. What is the total number of votes polled?

options_en: 17715
15177
11025
11577
questions.solution_en:
Winner = W
1st Runner up = R1
2nd Runner up = R2
Nota = N
R1= R2 + 150 ⇒R1 = N+900
R2=Nota+750⇒ R2 = N + 750
W=2 [Nota+750]⇒ W = 2N + 1500
Total votes = 2N +1500 + N + 900 + N + 750 + N
Total votes = 5N + 3150
Also given that, 2N +1500 + N + 900 + N + 750 = 6N
N = 1575
Total no of votes =3150+5×1575=11025

questions.q_en: What is the minimum number of cuts required to divide a cuboid into 16 equal cuboids?
questions.q_hi: एक घनाभ को 16 बराबर घनाभों में विभाजित करने के लिए कम-से-कम कितने कट लगाने की आवश्यकता होती है?
options_en: 2
3
5
4
options_hi: 2
3
5
4
questions.solution_en:
If we have x pieces along the length, y pieces along the width, and z pieces along the height, the total pieces = N

N = x * y * z

Total Cuts = (x - 1) + (y - 1) + (z - 1)

To get the minimum number of cuts, the values of x, y, and z must be as close to each other as possible (∛N).

N = 4 * 2 * 2

Thus,

Total no. of cuts = 3 + 1 + 1 = 5 cuts
questions.solution_hi:
यदि लंबाई के अनुदिश हमारे पास x टुकड़े, चौड़ाई के अनुदिश y टुकड़े और ऊँचाई के अनुदिश z टुकड़े हैं, तो कुल टुकड़े = N

N = x * y * z

कुल कट = (x - 1) + (y - 1) + (z - 1)

कटों की न्यूनतम संख्या प्राप्त करने के लिए, x, y और z के मान एक-दूसरे के जितना संभव हो सके, उतने करीब होने चाहिए (∛N)।

N = 4 * 2 * 2

अतः,

कुल कटों की संख्या = 3 + 1 + 1 = 5 कट

questions.q_en: A vendor sold 12 toys for ₹2,400 and gained a profit of 20%. How many toys should he sell for ₹3,300 to make a profit of 10%?
questions.q_hi: एक विक्रेता ने 12 खिलौने ₹2,400 में बेचे और 20% का लाभ कमाया। उसे 10% लाभ कमाने के लिए ₹3,300 में कितने खिलौने बेचने चाहिए?
options_en: 13
14
17
18
questions.solution_en:
SP of 1 toy = 200

CP of 1 toy = 200/6 × 5

for 10%P → SP of 1 toy = (200×5)/6 × 11/10

→Toys for Rs 3300= (3300×60)/(1000×11) = 18
questions.solution_hi:
प्रत्येक खिलौने का विक्रय मूल्य (SP) = ₹200
प्रत्येक खिलौने की लागत मूल्य (CP) = 200 / 6 × 5

10% लाभ के लिए → प्रत्येक खिलौने का SP = (200 × 5) / 6 × 11 / 10

₹3,300 के लिए बेचे जाने वाले खिलौने की संख्या = (3300 × 60) / (1000 × 11) = 18
